Rules:

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] Slotted target: host H (body) has shadow `<slot>` plus `target` as a light child of H; `ariaHideOutside([target])` sets `aria-hidden="true"` on the slot. The target has no own attribute, but its flat-tree ancestor is hidden. Repro: `expect(slot).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden')` → Received `aria-hidden="true"`. Slots aren't in the criteria, so this is your call, but the target is effectively hidden from AT.
- [minor] Perf (not in criteria): 5000 shadow siblings + 200 announcers, flag on, one call takes 4731 ms; HEAD on the same light-DOM size takes 337 ms. The per-node loop over `visibleNodes` with `nodeContains` drives it.
- [minor] Flag-off test is weaker than it looks: with the flag off, both HEAD and the new code set `aria-hidden` on `<body>` when the target sits in a shadow root. The existing `expect(target).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden')` passes only because the target itself isn't marked. Pre-existing; not a regression.
- [minor] The `shadowDOM` describe calls `enableShadowDOM()` in `beforeAll` and never resets it; the flag-off test is correct only because it runs earlier in the file. Not reproduced as a failure.
- Not a bug: my first probe expected a non-target host containing a live announcer to be hidden. The host is correctly skipped, so its ancestors aren't hidden.
